defect_observations.observation: V_* is used without definition and its value is not proved in the annex. Defining it as the worst limiting truncated risk 1/I_* of thm:p15-huber-general-minimax and adding the one-line deduction would close the C014 gap.

The statement's last sentence (body line 139, 'Convexity and compactness alone do not imply uniqueness') is neither proved nor cross-referenced in annex:p15.information.equality.components. The counterexample exists as thm:p15-fisher-minimizer-nonuniqueness (huber-robust-location.tex 328-339, annex 495-521), so coverage is credited, but the proof should cite it.

Consistency of the midpoint estimator on the centered class is justified 'as in the convex-estimator proof in thm:p15-convex-location-normality'. The applicable proved result is thm:p15-convex-location-consistency (huber-robust-location.tex 49-62), which is not cited.

lambda_F is used in the statements of thm:p15-information-closure-extension (line 228) and thm:p15-huber-general-minimax (line 308) without a definition in this chapter. It is defined only as lambda(t)=E_F psi(X-t) in thm:p15-convex-location-consistency and inside the annex proof (annex line 561).

N_fixed is called 'the smallest fixed sample allowing errors no larger than alpha, beta', but the annex (annex/p15/sequential-evidence.tex 311-316) checks only the one-sided threshold test. Minimality over all fixed-size tests needs the Neyman-Pearson lemma (thm:p15-neyman-pearson, hypothesis-tests-and-confidence.tex 95-123), which is not cited.
